description: HealthSignal Standardized 45 Syndrome Categories for Community Syndromic Surveillance

syndromes.name: Acute Febrile Illness
syndromes.description: Fever with chills, body ache, sweating, and general malaise without localized signs

syndromes.name: Upper Respiratory Infection (URI)
syndromes.description: Nasal congestion, rhinorrhea, sneezing, sore throat, mild cough

syndromes.name: Lower Respiratory Illness (Pneumonic)
syndromes.description: Productive cough, chest pain, dyspnea, rapid breathing, crackles/rales

syndromes.name: Influenza-Like Illness (ILI)
syndromes.description: Fever >= 38°C with cough, sore throat, and marked myalgia/fatigue

syndromes.name: Severe Acute Respiratory Infection (SARI)
syndromes.description: Acute respiratory illness with hypoxemia, tachypnea, and hospital admission demand

syndromes.name: Bronchospastic / Airway Obstruction
syndromes.description: Wheezing, chest tightness, prolonged expiration, asthma/COPD exacerbation

syndromes.name: Acute Watery Diarrheal Syndrome
syndromes.description: Frequent watery loose stools with rapid dehydration risk (cholera-like)

syndromes.name: Bloody Diarrhea / Dysenteric Syndrome
syndromes.description: Diarrhea with visible blood, mucus, tenesmus, and cramping abdominal pain

syndromes.name: Acute Gastroenteritis (Emetic-Predominant)
syndromes.description: Severe nausea, repeated vomiting, epigastric discomfort, and mild diarrhea (norovirus-like)

syndromes.name: Febrile Enteric Syndrome
syndromes.description: Prolonged fever, abdominal pain, hepatosplenomegaly, constipation/diarrhea (typhoid-like)

syndromes.name: Acute Jaundice / Hepatitic Syndrome
syndromes.description: Scleral/skin icterus, dark urine, pale stools, anorexia, right upper quadrant pain

syndromes.name: Acute Encephalitic Syndrome (AES)
syndromes.description: Fever with altered mental status, disorientation, confusion, seizures, or coma

syndromes.name: Meningeal Irritation Syndrome
syndromes.description: Severe headache, neck stiffness, photophobia, fever, Kernig/Brudzinski signs

syndromes.name: Acute Flaccid Paralysis (AFP)
syndromes.description: Rapid onset focal weakness/paralysis, hyporeflexia, asymmetric limb weakness

syndromes.name: Cranial Neuropathy / Neurotoxic
syndromes.description: Ptosis, diplopia, dysphagia, dysarthria, facial weakness (botulism/paralytic)

syndromes.name: Febrile Arthritic / Arboviral Syndrome
syndromes.description: High fever, severe polyarthralgia, joint swelling, backache (chikungunya-like)

syndromes.name: Viral Hemorrhagic Fever (VHF) Syndrome
syndromes.description: Fever, petechiae, purpura, mucosal bleeding, thrombocytopenia, capillary leak

syndromes.name: Acute Fever with Maculopapular Rash
syndromes.description: Fever accompanied by generalized maculopapular rash, conjunctivitis, coryza (measles-like)

syndromes.name: Vesiculopustular Eruptive Syndrome
syndromes.description: Fever with centrifugal/centripetal vesicles, pustules, crusted lesions (chickenpox/mpox)

syndromes.name: Cutaneous Ulcerative / Eschar Syndrome
syndromes.description: Localized painless/painful ulcer with black necrotic eschar, regional lymphadenopathy

syndromes.name: Mucocutaneous Lymph Node Syndrome
syndromes.description: Strawberry tongue, cracked lips, cervical lymphadenopathy, polymorphous exanthem

syndromes.name: Acute Allergic / Anaphylactic Syndrome
syndromes.description: Urticaria, angioedema, facial/tongue swelling, stridor, bronchospasm, hypotension

syndromes.name: Acute Coronary / Ischemic Syndrome
syndromes.description: Retrosternal chest pressure radiating to arm/jaw, diaphoresis, dyspnea

syndromes.name: Congestive Heart Failure / Volume Overload
syndromes.description: Orthopnea, paroxysmal nocturnal dyspnea, bilateral pedal edema, lung base crackles

syndromes.name: Arrhythmic / Syncope Syndrome
syndromes.description: Palpitations, sudden unheralded syncope, dizziness, pulse irregularities

syndromes.name: Systemic Inflammatory Response / Sepsis
syndromes.description: Fever/hypothermia, tachycardia, tachypnea, altered sensorium, oliguria, hypotension

syndromes.name: Severe Dehydration / Hypovolemic Shock
syndromes.description: Sunken eyes, delayed skin turgor, cold extremities, absent radial pulse, anuria

syndromes.name: Febrile Urinary / Pyelonephritis Syndrome
syndromes.description: Dysuria, frequency, urgency, accompanied by high fever, chills, and flank tenderness

syndromes.name: Acute Kidney Injury / Oliguric Syndrome
syndromes.description: Marked reduction in urine output, fluid retention, nausea, periorbital edema

syndromes.name: Acute Epidemic Conjunctivitis
syndromes.description: Bilateral/unilateral eye redness, purulent/serous discharge, eyelid edema, grittiness

syndromes.name: Acute Suppurative Otolaryngologic Syndrome
syndromes.description: Ear pain, otorrhea, acute tonsillopharyngeal exudates, trismus, stridor

syndromes.name: Oral Ulcerative / Stomatitis Syndrome
syndromes.description: Multiple painful oral vesicles/ulcers, gingival swelling, drooling, odynophagia

syndromes.name: Pediatric Croup / Inspiratory Stridor
syndromes.description: Barking seal-like cough, inspiratory stridor, suprasternal indrawing in infants/toddlers

syndromes.name: Acute Pediatric Wasting / Nutritional Crisis
syndromes.description: Rapid weight loss, visible muscle wasting, bilateral nutritional edema (kwashiorkor)

syndromes.name: Paroxysmal Malarial Fever Syndrome
syndromes.description: Cyclic tertian/quartan cold-hot-sweating stages, intense headache, splenomegaly

syndromes.name: Acute Filarial Adenolymphangitis
syndromes.description: Retrograde lymphangitis, localized painful edema of extremities/scrotum, fever

syndromes.name: Weil / Zoonotic Leptospiral Syndrome
syndromes.description: Fever, conjunctival suffusion, intense calf pain, jaundice, renal impairment

syndromes.name: Hydrophobic / Zoonotic Encephalopathy
syndromes.description: Aerophobia, hydrophobia, localized paresthesia at bite site, agitation, autonomic storm

syndromes.name: Foodborne Neurotoxic / Paralytic
syndromes.description: Acute descending motor weakness, fixed dilated pupils, dry mouth after food exposure

syndromes.name: Environmental Heat Stress / Heat Stroke
syndromes.description: Hyperthermia > 40°C, anhidrosis/profuse sweating, delirium, ataxia during heatwave

syndromes.name: Environmental Cold Injury / Hypothermia
syndromes.description: Core body temperature < 35°C, slurred speech, shivering cessation, peripheral cyanosis

syndromes.name: Toxic Gas / Irritant Inhalation Syndrome
syndromes.description: Acute burning of eyes/airways, lacrimation, non-cardiogenic pulmonary edema cluster

syndromes.name: Acute Hemolytic / Cytopenic Syndrome
syndromes.description: Sudden severe pallor, fatigue, dark tea-colored urine, acute splenomegaly

syndromes.name: Post-Acute Infectious Asthenia / Long-Syndrome
syndromes.description: Persistent disabling fatigue, brain fog, autonomic tachycardia following viral illness

syndromes.name: Unspecified Syndromic Cluster
syndromes.description: Statistical anomaly in health-seeking behavior not mapped to defined clinical syndromes
